license_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice medicine, osteopathic medicine, chiropractic, or podiatry or as a physician assistant in the Commonwealth without a valid unrevoked license issued by the Board.

type.quote: The Board of Medicine shall consist of one medical physician from each congressional district, one osteopathic physician, one podiatrist, one chiropractor, and four citizen members.

umbrella_agency.quote: The following boards are included within the Department: Board of Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology, Board of Counseling, Board of Dentistry, Board of Funeral Directors and Embalmers, Board of Long-Term Care Administrators, Board of Medicine, Board of Nursing, Board of Optometry, Board of Pharmacy, Board of Physical Therapy, Board of Psychology, Board of Social Work, and Board of Veterinary Medicine.

age_minimum.quote: Is 18 years of age or more;

degree_required.value: Graduate of a medical school; successful completion of an educational course of study acceptable to the Board
degree_required.quote: Has successfully completed all or such part as may be prescribed by the Board, of an educational course of study of that branch of the healing arts in which he desires a license to practice, which course of study and the educational institution providing that course of study are acceptable to the Board

accrediting_body.value: Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education; Liaison Committee on Medical Education; Council on Postgraduate Training of the American Osteopathic Association; Commission on Osteopathic College Accreditation; Education Commission on Foreign Medical Graduates; Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada; and others approved by the Board
accrediting_body.quote: the Board may consider the reputation of the institution and whether it is approved or accredited by regional or national educational or professional associations, including such organizations as the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, Liaison Committee on Medical Education, Council on Postgraduate Training of the American Osteopathic Association, Commission on Osteopathic College Accreditation, College of Family Physicians of Canada, Committee for the Accreditation of Canadian Medical Schools, Education Commission on Foreign Medical Graduates, Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, or their appropriate subsidiary agencies

degree_level.quote: Has successfully completed all or such part as may be prescribed by the Board, of an educational course of study of that branch of the healing arts in which he desires a license to practice, which course of study and the educational institution providing that course of study are acceptable to the Board

school_approval_basis.quote: the Board may consider the reputation of the institution and whether it is approved or accredited by regional or national educational or professional associations, including such organizations as the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, Liaison Committee on Medical Education

credential_pegged.quote: Has successfully completed all or such part as may be prescribed by the Board, of an educational course of study of that branch of the healing arts in which he desires a license to practice, which course of study and the educational institution providing that course of study are acceptable to the Board

required.quote: Has completed at least 12 months of satisfactory postgraduate training in one program or institution approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the Board for internships or residency training.

experience_source.quote: Has completed at least 12 months of satisfactory postgraduate training in one program or institution approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the Board for internships or residency training.

duration.quote: Has completed at least 12 months of satisfactory postgraduate training in one program or institution approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the Board for internships or residency training.

kind.quote: at least 12 months of satisfactory postgraduate training in one program or institution approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the Board for internships or residency training

exams.name: National Board of Medical Examiners (NBME) examination
exams.notes: Board may also accept Federation of State Medical Boards or National Board of Osteopathic Medical Examiners examinations, or other examinations as determined by the Board.
exams.quote: The examinations of candidates for licensure to practice medicine and osteopathy shall be those of the National Board of Medical Examiners, the Federation of State Medical Boards, the National Board of Osteopathic Medical Examiners, or such other examinations as determined by the Board.

interval_years.quote: Every license granted under the provisions of this chapter shall be renewed biennially as prescribed by the Board.

required.quote: The Board shall prescribe by regulation such requirements as may be necessary to ensure continued practitioner competence, which may include continuing education, testing, or any other requirement.

available.quote: The Board, in its discretion, may issue certificates or licenses to applicants upon endorsement by boards or other appropriate authorities of other states or territories or the District of Columbia with which reciprocal relations have not been established if the credentials of such applicants are satisfactory and the examinations and passing grades required by such other boards are fully equal to those required by the Virginia Board.

requirements.value: Credentials must be satisfactory and examinations/passing grades must be fully equal to Virginia Board requirements. Board may also accept national board certificates if credentials, schools, and examination results are acceptable. The Board shall prioritize applicants from contiguous states for streamlined processing within 20 days.
requirements.quote: The Board may issue certificates or licenses to applicants holding certificates from the national boards of their respective branches of the healing arts if their credentials, schools of graduation and national board examinations and results are acceptable to the Board.

exists.quote: The Board of Medicine shall consist of one medical physician from each congressional district, one osteopathic physician, one podiatrist, one chiropractor, and four citizen members.

national_certification.value: National Board of Medical Examiners (NBME); Federation of State Medical Boards (FSMB); National Board of Osteopathic Medical Examiners (NBOME)
national_certification.quote: The examinations of candidates for licensure to practice medicine and osteopathy shall be those of the National Board of Medical Examiners, the Federation of State Medical Boards, the National Board of Osteopathic Medical Examiners, or such other examinations as determined by the Board.

national_association.value: Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME); American Osteopathic Association; American Podiatric Medical Association
national_association.quote: any graduate medical, osteopathic, or podiatric education at any institution approved by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, the American Osteopathic Association or the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice medicine, osteopathic medicine, chiropractic, or podiatry or as a physician assistant in the Commonwealth without a valid unrevoked license issued by the Board.

credential_type.quote: Upon completion of an application satisfactory to the Board, applicants shall be granted licenses to practice medicine, osteopathy, chiropractic, or podiatry

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice medicine, osteopathic medicine, chiropractic, or podiatry or as a physician assistant in the Commonwealth without a valid unrevoked license issued by the Board.

title_protection.quote: No person shall practice or hold himself out as qualified to practice medicine, osteopathy, chiropractic, or podiatry without obtaining a license from the Board of Medicine as provided in this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice medicine, osteopathic medicine, chiropractic, or podiatry or as a physician assistant in the Commonwealth without a valid unrevoked license issued by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: False statements, representations, fraud, or deceit in obtaining admission to practice or in the practice of any branch of the healing arts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False statements or representations or fraud or deceit in obtaining admission to the practice, or fraud or deceit in the practice of any branch of the healing arts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Substance abuse rendering the licensee unfit for the performance of professional obligations and duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Substance abuse rendering him unfit for the performance of his professional obligations and duties

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentional or negligent conduct in the practice of any branch of the healing arts that causes or is likely to cause injury to a patient or patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentional or negligent conduct in the practice of any branch of the healing arts that causes or is likely to cause injury to a patient or patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical incapacity or incompetence to practice the profession with safety to patients and the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental or physical incapacity or incompetence to practice his profession with safety to his patients and the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Restriction of a license to practice a branch of the healing arts in another state, the District of Columbia, a US possession/territory, or foreign jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Restriction of a license to practice a branch of the healing arts in another state, the District of Columbia, a United States possession or territory, or a foreign jurisdiction, or for an entity of the federal government

disciplinary_grounds.description: Undertaking in any manner to procure or perform or aid or abet in procuring or performing a criminal abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Undertaking in any manner or by any means whatsoever to procure or perform or aid or abet in procuring or performing a criminal abortion

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of any of the healing arts under a false or assumed name, or impersonating another practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of any of the healing arts under a false or assumed name, or impersonating another practitioner of a like, similar, or different name

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or dispensing any controlled substance with intent or knowledge that it will be used otherwise than medicinally or for accepted therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing or dispensing any controlled substance with intent or knowledge that it will be used otherwise than medicinally, or for accepted therapeutic purposes, or with intent to evade any law with respect to the sale, use, or disposition of such drug

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating provisions on division of fees or practicing in violation of the provisions of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating provisions of this chapter on division of fees or practicing any branch of the healing arts in violation of the provisions of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly and willfully committing a felony under the laws of the Commonwealth or the United States, or a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly and willfully committing an act that is a felony under the laws of the Commonwealth or the United States, or any act that is a misdemeanor under such laws and involves moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting, having professional connection with, or lending name to any person known to be practicing illegally any of the healing arts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting, having professional connection with, or lending his name to any person known to him to be practicing illegally any of the healing arts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting practice in a manner contrary to the standards of ethics of the licensee's branch of the healing arts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conducting his practice in a manner contrary to the standards of ethics of his branch of the healing arts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting practice in such a manner as to be a danger to the health and welfare of patients or the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conducting his practice in such a manner as to be a danger to the health and welfare of his patients or to the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable skill or safety because of illness or substance abuse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice with reasonable skill or safety because of illness or substance abuse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing an advertisement relating to professional practice that contains a claim of superiority or violates Board advertising regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing in any manner an advertisement relating to his professional practice that contains a claim of superiority or violates Board regulations governing advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any act likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any act likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of statute or regulation relating to the manufacture, distribution, dispensing, or administration of drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of statute or regulation, state or federal, relating to the manufacture, distribution, dispensing, or administration of drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or cooperating with others in violating any provisions of applicable chapters or Board regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or cooperating with others in violating any of the provisions of Chapters 1 (§ 54.1-100 et seq.), 24 (§ 54.1-2400 et seq.) and this chapter or regulations of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual contact with a patient concurrent with and by virtue of the practitioner-patient relationship or lewd and offensive conduct toward a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in sexual contact with a patient concurrent with and by virtue of the practitioner and patient relationship or otherwise engaging at any time during the course of the practitioner and patient relationship in conduct of a sexual nature that a reasonable patient would consider lewd and offensive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction in any state, territory, or country of any felony or of any crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction in any state, territory, or country of any felony or of any crime involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudication of legal incompetence or incapacity in any state, if in effect and the person has not been declared restored
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Adjudication of legal incompetence or incapacity in any state if such adjudication is in effect and the person has not been declared restored to competence or capacity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing services of a medical examiner without being listed on the National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners as required by federal regulation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing the services of a medical examiner as defined in 49 C.F.R. § 390.5 if, at the time such services are performed, the person performing such services is not listed on the National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing to complete and file electronically any medical certification in the Electronic Death Registration System as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing to complete and file electronically using the Electronic Death Registration System any medical certification in accordance with the requirements of subsection C of § 32.1-263.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine" means the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of human physical or mental ailments, conditions, diseases, pain, or infirmities by any means or method.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine or osteopathic medicine" means the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of human physical or mental ailments, conditions, diseases, pain, or infirmities by any means or method.

methods_authorized.quote: the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of human physical or mental ailments, conditions, diseases, pain, or infirmities by any means or method

drug_authority.value: Physicians may administer controlled substances to their patients or provide controlled substances in a bona fide medical emergency or when pharmaceutical services are not available. Physicians may prescribe pain-relieving agents in excess of recommended dosages upon certifying medical necessity in the patient's medical record.
drug_authority.quote: this prohibition shall not apply to a doctor of medicine, osteopathy or podiatry who administers controlled substances to his patients or provides controlled substances to his patient in a bona fide medical emergency or when pharmaceutical services are not available

license_status_types.quote: The Board may issue a retiree license to any doctor of medicine, osteopathy, podiatry, or chiropractic who holds an unrestricted, active license to practice in the Commonwealth

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign graduates must exhibit a diploma, license, or certificate conferring full right to practice in their country, or satisfactory evidence of completing equivalent coursework and examinations. Additionally, the Board may issue provisional licenses to internationally trained physicians who have an ECFMG certificate (or equivalent), passing scores on USMLE Steps 1 and 2 CK, and enter an agreement with a medical care facility for assessment and evaluation.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Every candidate who is a graduate of a school of a country other than the United States and Canada must, in addition to meeting the other requirements of this article, exhibit to the Board a diploma, license or certificate conferring the full right to practice in that country, or satisfactory evidence showing that the candidate has completed the course of study and passed examinations equivalent to those required for a diploma or license conferring such full right to practice.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Has completed at least 12 months of satisfactory postgraduate training in one program or institution approved by an accrediting agency recognized by the Board for internships or residency training.

pain_management_education_required.quote: The Board shall adopt regulations for the prescribing of opioids and products containing buprenorphine.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: The Board shall adopt regulations for the prescribing of opioids including limitations on dosages or day supply for acute pain, requirements for appropriate patient history and evaluation, documentation requirements, and mandatory Prescription Monitoring Program checks. Chronic pain treatment requires additional requirements including a treatment plan and periodic review.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Such regulations shall include guidelines for: 1. The treatment of acute pain, which shall include (i) requirements for an appropriate patient history and evaluation, (ii) limitations on dosages or day supply of drugs prescribed, (iii) requirements for appropriate documentation in the patient's health record, and (iv) a requirement that the prescriber request and review information contained in the Prescription Monitoring Program

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: a requirement that the prescriber request and review information contained in the Prescription Monitoring Program in accordance with § 54.1-2522.1

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Out-of-state physicians may provide continuity of care via telemedicine to current patients in Virginia if a practitioner-patient relationship was previously established and an in-person examination was performed within the previous 12 months.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: such practice is for the purpose of providing continuity of care through the use of telemedicine services as defined in § 38.2-3418.16 and (ii) the patient is a current patient of the practitioner with whom the practitioner has previously established a practitioner-patient relationship and the practitioner has performed an in-person examination of the patient within the previous 12 months

telemedicine_license_available.quote: Any doctor of medicine or osteopathy, physician assistant, respiratory therapist, occupational therapist, or advanced practice registered nurse who would otherwise be subject to licensure by the Board who holds an active, unrestricted license in another state or the District of Columbia and who is in good standing with the applicable regulatory agency in that state or the District of Columbia from engaging in the practice of that profession in the Commonwealth with a patient located in the Commonwealth when (i) such practice is for the purpose of providing continuity of care through the use of telemedicine services

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: every physician assistant shall practice as part of a patient care team and shall provide care in accordance with a written or electronic practice agreement with one or more patient care team physicians or patient care team podiatrists.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Licensed physician assistants may prescribe controlled substances and devices as authorized by the practice agreement or facility credentialing arrangement. The practice agreement must include a statement of controlled substances the PA is or is not authorized to prescribe.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: a licensed physician assistant shall have the authority to prescribe controlled substances and devices as set forth in Chapter 34 (§ 54.1-3400 et seq.) and as provided in a practice agreement or by the credentialing and privileging practice arrangement requirements of a facility

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: No patient care team physician or patient care team podiatrist shall be allowed to collaborate or consult with more than six physician assistants on a patient care team at any one time.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Any malpractice judgment against a person licensed under this chapter; 3. Any settlement of a malpractice claim against a person licensed under this chapter

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Any disciplinary action taken during or at the conclusion of disciplinary proceedings or while under investigation, including but not limited to denial or termination of employment, denial or termination of privileges or restriction of privileges

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: When a board has probable cause to believe a practitioner is unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety to patients because of excessive use of alcohol or drugs or physical or mental illness, the board, after preliminary investigation by an informal fact-finding proceeding, may direct that the practitioner submit to a mental or physical examination.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: When a board has probable cause to believe a practitioner is unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety to patients because of excessive use of alcohol or drugs or physical or mental illness, the board, after preliminary investigation by an informal fact-finding proceeding, may direct that the practitioner submit to a mental or physical examination. Failure to submit to the examination shall constitute grounds for disciplinary action.
